metrics.thd_definition: 2nd through 40th integer multiples of the fundamental; carrier band excluded
metrics.switching_band_note: Both fsw and 2*fsw neighborhoods are reported because the differential unipolar bridge can concentrate ripple near 2*fsw.
metrics.inductor_residual_definition: peak-to-peak after least-squares removal of DC and 50 Hz only; includes harmonics and switching ripple

losses.completeness: partial; excludes core, capacitor ESR, gate drive, controls, auxiliaries and thermal iteration

windows.selection_reason: Final four complete cycles with full switching ripple.

windows.purpose: one final fundamental cycle for magnetic analysis
windows.selection_reason: Full-resolution current and induced voltage; no decimation.

analysis_notes: Actual Simulink result. Web JSON waveforms are display-only decimation; C must use the full MAT/CSV.
Legacy THD is harmonics 2 through 40 over the final four whole cycles; it excludes the carrier band.
Winding I^2R is a constant-R DC-ohmic estimate. It is not total inverter loss or whole-inverter efficiency.
Device loss parameters and limitations are recorded in loss_basis_v1.json.
